evidence_passages: If classifier A achieves significantly higher accuracy on PAWS than classifier B, we can conclude that A better tracks the underlying predicate–argument structure of the premise when determining entailment, even when the hypothesis reuses nearly all the same words.
As a secondary diagnostic, also report scores on HANS (Heuristic Analysis for NLI) to confirm the winner does not simply exploit shallow syntactic heuristics.
rationale: The final conditional makes significantly better PAWS paraphrase accuracy sufficient for directional argument-role entailment. HANS is a useful secondary check but no relevant role-sensitive NLI result explicitly governs that conclusion; no disagreement rule or actual missing-task qualification cures it.
charitable_reading: The HANS confirmation wording could suggest a required cross-check. An explicitly governing target-role NLI check would cure the mismatch, and a qualified PAWS proxy would pass; that is not clearly supplied here.

source_verification_records.finding: Primary paper defines PAWS as high-lexical-overlap paraphrase/non-paraphrase pairs, generated by controlled swapping and back translation with human judgments.
Official labels are 0 for different meaning and 1 for paraphrase; PAWS-Wiki and PAWS-QQP are paraphrase-identification resources.
Primary paper defines HANS as controlled NLI diagnostics for lexical-overlap, subsequence and constituent heuristics.
Official scorer uses entailment/non-entailment; contradiction and neutral predictions are both mapped to non-entailment.

confidence: high, qualitative and uncalibrated; acknowledges charitable reading of the HANS clause

mapping_explanation: Non-paraphrase does not determine whether the ordered NLI relation is entailment, neutral, or contradiction. Ideal mutual entailment can motivate a specified bidirectional adapter, but binary PAWS labels alone do not provide directional NLI supervision.
corrected_evaluation: Both unchanged NLI systems on identical preselected role-sensitive HANS cases and matched entailment controls; neutral/contradiction collapsed to non-entailment; governing role-sensitive and contrast-level results; bounded conclusion. PAWS is separate validated paraphrase proxy.

Not performed and no reversal presumed.
